correctness.rationale: The algebra products follow the integral Zinbiel binomial table. Every automorphism comes from an invertible generator substitution, giving a triangular matrix with diagonal a,a²,a³,a⁴. The invariant three-space action is calculated without division, and all characteristic-dependent degeneracies are handled separately. Normal-form reductions classify every stratum, and delta, theta and eta distinguish all normal forms. The packaged exhaustive finite-field checks in characteristics 2,3,5,7,11 corroborate the all-field algebraic proof; they are not treated as its substitute.

It detects new characteristic-dependent geometry: a uniformly bounded orbit spectrum for p>=5 breaks into q-parameter modular orbit families in p=2,3, with explicit complete invariants.
